subject: Approval to Close Range 14 for Maintenance
addressees: Commander, 4th Infantry Division, 1633 Mekong Street, Fort Carson, CO  80913-4321

paragraphs.text: _PURPOSE_.  To obtain CG approval to close Range 14 from 3 August 2026 through 7 August 2026 for scheduled surface danger zone maintenance.
_RECOMMENDATION(S)_.  CG approve the Range 14 closure and direct subordinate battalions to reschedule live-fire iterations before 25 July 2026.
_BACKGROUND_.  Range Control scheduled surface danger zone maintenance that requires a five-day closure.  Live-fire reservations already on the calendar must move before 25 July 2026.
_DISCUSSION_.  Closing Range 14 for the full window lets Range Control replace target lifters and repair the north berm without interrupting unfinished work.
COA 1:  Close Range 14 3-7 August 2026.  Advantage: completes all maintenance.  Disadvantage: forces units to rebook training.
COA 2:  Delay maintenance to September.  Advantage: preserves August training.  Disadvantage: leaves failed lifters in place.
_IMPACT_.  Affects battalion live-fire calendars for early August.  No additional personnel or funding required beyond the programmed maintenance package.
_COORDINATION_.  Staffed with Range Control and the Garrison Safety Office on 16 July 2026.
My point of contact for this action is Mr. David Okonkwo, ATZB-RC, at 719-555-0142 or david.a.okonkwo.civ@army.mil.
